node.statement: Typed diagonal-range facts: by def-stochastic, Q_C:C^n->C^n is positive and unital; since its domain is commutative it is UCP. The diagonal inclusion J is a unital *-homomorphism and hence UCP, while D([a_ij])=(a_11,...,a_nn) is UCP because every amplification sends a positive block matrix [A_ij] to the direct sum of its positive diagonal compressions. Thus Phi=J Q_C D is UCP and, by node 1.1, contractive; Phi(a) lies in J(C^n), any two elements in its range commute, D J=I_{C^n}, and J is isometric. Moreover every positive linear map is *-preserving, so D,Delta,Upsilon,J and iota_C whenever defined carry self-adjoint elements to self-adjoint elements.
